Yeo’s Social Media (2023 – 2025)

Company: Spin Communications
Role: Video Editor & Motion Designer

What I did,
- 2D motion graphics and animation, plus light 3D where needed
- Compositing, including green-screen keying and cleanup
- AI-generated shots made in Magnifique AI Suite and composited into the live footage
- Edit, music and sound design

Tools:
After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, Magnifique AI Suite

Team:
Executive Creative Director, Art Director, Videographer, Copywriter

Turnaround:
2-3 days per 2 videos, ongoing for 2+ years

Challenge:
Some green-screen footage had uneven lighting and glitchy frames. I rebalanced the key, cleaned up the problem frames by hand, and finished the online effects pass, so the final videos stayed clean and consistent.
